Fixed two ways: (1) factored the checkpoint-loading logic out of FuguSelectionDispatch.__init__ into a new shared open_fugu.models.worker_backend.load_from_checkpoint(checkpoint_path, available_worker_ids, device) -- used by both FuguSelectionDispatch (Phase 5+, unchanged behavior for its own SFT checkpoints) and m7's own m5_sft/m6_cmaes conditions -- which only loads 'svf_z' if the key is present (a freshly-constructed OrchestratorBackbone already has the correct no-op z otherwise, so omitting it is not an error); (2) scripts/m6_cmaes_gardner_pilot.py's own checkpoint save now also writes 'svf_z' (the already-no-op values) for shape-consistency with m5/Phase 4's checkpoints, so this is never the special case in practice either.
